build_SimplePPOPolicy: build a SimplePPOPolicy agent that restores a PPO policy network from a TensorFlow checkpoint
create_get_action: create a function call to get_action that returns denormalized actions from a given observation
restore_policy_from_checkpoint: restore a PPO policy network from a TensorFlow checkpoint using policy and value layer configurations
normalize_observations: normalize environment observations to a -1 to 1 range using observation space bounds
denormalize_actions: denormalize policy actions from -1 to 1 range back to the environment action space bounds
